name: Forio (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Forio (a rose on blue above rocks).
history: Municipal flag of Forio, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Forio arms — rose on blue above rocks, crowned
